SELECT r.registration_id AS registrationId, r.event_id AS eventId, r.session_id AS sessionId, s.name AS sessionName, r.lead_id AS leadId, r.contact_id AS contactId, r.audience_key AS audienceKey, r.display_name AS displayName, r.mobile_phone AS mobilePhone, r.registration_status AS registrationStatus, r.registration_source AS registrationSource, r.registered_at AS registeredAt, CASE WHEN c.check_in_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'checked_in' ELSE 'not_checked_in' END AS checkInStatus, c.checked_in_at AS checkedInAt FROM crm_event_registration r JOIN crm_event_session s ON s.session_id = r.session_id AND s.tenant_id = r.tenant_id LEFT JOIN crm_event_check_in c ON c.event_id = r.event_id AND c.session_id = r.session_id AND c.audience_key = r.audience_key AND c.tenant_id = r.tenant_id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.event_id = #{eventId} AND r.registration_source <> 'market_event'
AND r.session_id = #{query.sessionId}

AND (r.display_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR r.mobile_phone ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))

SELECT r.registration_id AS registrationId, r.event_id AS eventId, r.session_id AS sessionId, s.name AS sessionName, r.lead_id AS leadId, r.contact_id AS contactId, r.audience_key AS audienceKey, r.display_name AS displayName, r.mobile_phone AS mobilePhone, r.registration_status AS registrationStatus, r.registration_source AS registrationSource, r.registered_at AS registeredAt, r.form_data::text AS formDataJson, r.custom_field AS customField, CASE WHEN c.check_in_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'checked_in' ELSE 'not_checked_in' END AS checkInStatus, c.checked_in_at AS checkedInAt FROM crm_event_registration r JOIN crm_event_session s ON s.session_id = r.session_id AND s.tenant_id = r.tenant_id LEFT JOIN crm_event_check_in c ON c.event_id = r.event_id AND c.session_id = r.session_id AND c.audience_key = r.audience_key AND c.tenant_id = r.tenant_id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.event_id = #{eventId} AND r.registration_id = #{registrationId} AND r.registration_source <> 'market_event' LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.audience_key) r.audience_key AS audienceKey, r.registration_status AS registrationStatus, s.name AS sessionName FROM crm_event_registration r JOIN crm_event_session s ON s.session_id = r.session_id AND s.tenant_id = r.tenant_id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.event_id = #{eventId} AND r.registration_source <> 'market_event' ORDER BY r.audience_key, CASE r.registration_status WHEN 'confirmed' THEN 1 WHEN 'waitlist' THEN 2 WHEN 'cancelled' THEN 3 END, r.registered_at DESC

mapper.sql: SELECT r.registration_id AS registrationId, r.registration_source AS registrationSource, r.event_id AS eventId, CASE WHEN r.registration_source = 'market_event' THEN COALESCE(me.title_cn, r.form_data->>'event_name') ELSE COALESCE(e.subject, r.form_data->>'event_name') END AS eventTitle, r.session_id AS sessionId, s.name AS sessionName, r.lead_id AS leadId, r.contact_id AS contactId, r.registration_status AS registrationStatus, r.registered_at AS registeredAt, CASE WHEN c.check_in_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'checked_in' ELSE 'not_checked_in' END AS checkInStatus, c.checked_in_at AS checkedInAt, r.form_data::text AS formDataJson, r.custom_field AS customField, r.display_name AS displayName, r.mobile_phone AS mobilePhone FROM crm_event_registration r LEFT JOIN crm_market_event me ON me.id = r.event_id AND r.registration_source = 'market_event' LEFT JOIN crm_event e ON e.event_id = r.event_id AND r.registration_source <> 'market_event' LEFT JOIN crm_event_session s ON s.session_id = r.session_id AND s.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND r.registration_source <> 'market_event' LEFT JOIN crm_event_check_in c ON c.registration_id = r.registration_id
